summary: Backend regression for the rewritten Buried Treasure feature. Built /app/backend/tests/test_buried_treasure_v2.py with 35 tests across SOLO, FRIENDS (groups), join-by-code, available-lobby, and old-endpoints-gone. Result: 34 PASSED / 1 SKIPPED (skip is intentional: the success path of /api/bt/solo/find cannot be exercised purely via public API since chest coordinates are deliberately hidden — the equivalent TestSoloFindDirect class resolves coords via motor and passes). Every spec'd behaviour is verified: radius clamping (100m..25km), chest concealment in responses, compass shape ({distance_m, bearing_deg, in_find_ring, find_ring_m=15}), 15 m proximity + photo enforcement, 100 XP award + auto-assign of next solo chest in same area, group 6-char code (uppercase A-Z minus ambiguous chars + 2-9), creator auto-accepted, 50 km friend-area check with rejected_too_far/rejected_other arrays, non-creator cannot invite (403), bury blocked until all invitees accept, creator-cannot-find-own-chest (403), winner flips group to 'finished' with found_by/found_at, compass+find blocked once finished, join-by-code uppercases input/rejects far users/404 on unknown/400 on short, groups/available lists lobby groups created by friends. Push-token wiring did not raise — push collection lookups completed without traceback during invite/accept/reject/bury/find calls (backend logs clean).
action_items: Optional: /app/backend/buried_treasure.py is 880 lines (>700-line guideline). Consider splitting into bt_solo.py + bt_groups.py + bt_shared.py if more flows are added.
critical_code_review_comments: buried_treasure.py = 880 lines, slightly above the 700-line module budget. Functionally fine, but a future split would help readability.

Solo success-path cannot be tested through the public API alone because chest coords are intentionally hidden. The test suite covers it via a direct motor read to db.bt_solo — main agent should keep this constraint in mind if a future change adds a /debug/chest endpoint.
Old /api/bt/* endpoints (chest/today, finds, no-go-zones, settings, feed, matches) all return 404 cleanly — no leftover handlers, no tracebacks in backend logs.

success_rate.backend: 100% (34/34 executed, 1 intentional skip replaced by direct-DB equivalent which also passed)

seed_data_creation: Two throwaway gmail.com test users registered per session (TEST_bt_*@gmail.com) and befriended to admin to exercise the 50 km friend-area logic. Test data is left in DB; main agent can purge by user_id prefix or email LIKE 'TEST_bt_%' if desired.
